about: Beloeil is a South Shore city in Montérégie, on the Richelieu River facing Mont-Saint-Hilaire across the water. It combines a riverside village character with suburban neighbourhoods and is closely tied to the mountain’s trails and apple country. The Jacques-Cartier bridge over the Richelieu links Beloeil to McMasterville and Mont-Saint-Hilaire. About 24,000 people live in Beloeil.
seoSummary: Richelieu River city facing Mont-Saint-Hilaire, a South Shore community of river and mountain views.
